name: GDP (current US$)
sourceNote: GDP at purchaser's prices is the sum of gross value added by all resident producers in the economy plus any product taxes and minus any subsidies not included in the value of the products. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sourceOrganization: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

name: GDP per capita (current US$)
sourceNote: GDP per capita is gross domestic product divided by midyear population.
sourceOrganization: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

name: GDP per capita growth (annual %)
sourceNote: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP per capita based on constant local currency.
sourceOrganization: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files.

name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
sourceNote: Unemployment refers to the share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
sourceOrganization: International Labour Organization. ILO Modelled Estimates database.
